---
agent: 'agent'
description: 'Review the selected ticket exercise diff against its tests'
---

Review the current diff in the selected Python or JavaScript track. Read `docs/problem-brief.md`, `.github/copilot-instructions.md`, and the selected track's tests. Do not edit files. Report: (1) any mismatch with the D1/D2 acceptance criteria, (2) test result or a command to reproduce it, (3) unrelated changes or weakened tests, (4) one concrete risk, and (5) a recommendation to accept, revise, or reject. Cite file paths and lines. Distinguish observed results from assumptions.
